admission_gates.input_token_parity: provider-reported input token counts identical across matched cells; byte equality insufficient
admission_gates.route_stability: response-side model string and backend fingerprint stable within a block; violating blocks invalidated
admission_gates.invalidated_cells: excluded before analysis and reported in the invalidated-cell ledger

kxr_lattice.estimator: blocked mixed-effects model over latency and accuracy with block random effects; K, R, E fixed effects

token_compute_residual.definition: latency unexplained after observed input, cached, output, and reasoning tokens

continuation_reuse.matched_on: cached token counts and byte-identical reconstructed transcript
continuation_reuse.rationale: KV reuse is universal; only an accuracy delta at matched cache indicates state carried beyond text

reporting_truthfulness.rule: RECURRENT_DEPTH_CONSISTENT requires residual growth with R at approximately constant reported reasoning tokens
reporting_truthfulness.on_violation: strongest admissible terminal for R-sensitive results is HIDDEN_SERIAL_OR_RECURRENT_INDISTINGUISHABLE

classifier.features: normalized shape invariants only: signs, normalized slopes, knee locations, monotonicity classes
calibration_controls: LoopCoder-v2 7B parallel-loop (positive: parallel latent; non-monotonic loop-count control)
classifier.frozen: at stage 2, before any subject call
classifier.out_of_distribution_return: INCONCLUSIVE permitted; forcing the subject into a known family prohibited

amendment_rules.stage_2_may: fill fields marked stage_2_numeric: pending; freeze generator implementations
amendment_rules.stage_2_may_not: alter hypotheses, terminals, gates, endpoints, or the two-stage freeze section
amendment_rules.any_other_change: new preregistration under a new id

subject_binding.rule: a contract binds only an exact callable identifier, in a separate private manifest, never in this file
